subject.title: fix(feishu): use union_id as fallback for @mention detection in multi-bot groups

question: Which Feishu bot identity strategy should become canonical for multi-bot group @mention admission when Feishu open_id values are app-scoped?
rationale: The proposed union_id source is disputed by the linked issue, the branch conflicts across the identity decision surface, and a wrong admission strategy can suppress or misroute Feishu group messages.

options.title: Rewrite Around Proven Identity
options.body: Rework this PR on current main only after proving the stable identity source and covering all mention admission paths.

options.title: Supersede With Broader Feishu Work
options.body: Keep this PR as investigation context until a broader Feishu identity or bot-to-bot PR lands with positive proof.

options.title: Document Current Limitation
options.body: If Feishu does not expose a reliable cross-app bot identity, keep requireMention conservative and document supported multi-bot workarounds.
